fg_e_frost_desc: A huge icy wave that freezes enemies solid.
invite_message: I'm playing 17 fun mini games in Mini Games Hub. Join me! %1$s
game_fox_desc: A classic side-scrolling platformer! Run, jump, stomp enemies and collect the 3 stars in 15 handmade levels across meadow, cave and castle.
fx_how_to: Move with ← →, jump with the button — hold it to jump higher. Stomp snails and bees, but never the spiky hedgehogs! Hit ? blocks from below.
fx_all_done: You finished every level! Try to collect all the stars.
game_block_rain_desc: The classic falling-blocks game! Rotate and slide the pieces, complete lines and speed up level by level.
br_how: Tap: rotate · Drag sideways: move · Drag down: drop faster · Quick swipe down: drop · Quick swipe up: hold
game_checkers_desc: Turkish draughts against the computer (3 levels) or a friend. Capture is mandatory, become a king and sweep the board!
ck_rules: Turkish draughts: pieces move one square forward or sideways and capture by jumping. A piece reaching the last row becomes a king and moves any distance. Capturing is mandatory and you must take the most pieces.
game_chess_desc: Full chess rules with castling, en passant and promotion. Play the computer (3 levels) or a friend on the same phone.
game_dress_up_desc: Dress up your model! Pick hair, clothes, shoes and accessories in any color, match the theme and win over the judges.
du_result_1: Not bad – try matching the theme more.
du_result_0: Hmm… this doesn't fit the theme.
game_makeup_desc: Customers come with a look in mind! Rub on eyeshadow, blush and lipstick with your finger, choose lashes and add sparkly stickers.
mk_wipe_hint: Rub the face to remove makeup.
mk_result_3: She loves it! Exactly what she wanted.
mk_result_1: Hmm, not quite what she asked for.
mk_result_0: Oops! That's not her style at all.
game_cake_shop_desc: Bake cakes for your customers! Add the ingredients, stir the batter, bake it just right, spread the frosting and decorate.
ck2_hint_ingredients: Add flour, sugar, eggs, milk and the %1$s flavor.
ck2_wrong: Oops! That's not in the recipe.
